claims.claim: Cold starts could also push some notifications past 2 seconds.
claims.about: .NET (C#) Azure Functions isolated worker on the consumption plan
claims.measured: csharp-aspnet start-up 785 ms (in a Docker container, 1 CPU)
claims.why: The 785 ms figure is how long an ASP.NET Core server takes to start in a container that already exists, but an Azure Functions consumption-plan cold start also includes the platform allocating an instance and loading the Functions host and worker, which the measurements don't cover.
